text: 我姐姐在医院工作。她早上七点去医院，下午六点下班，晚上在家做饭。
textEnglish: My older sister works at a hospital. She goes to the hospital at seven in the morning, finishes work at six in the afternoon, and cooks at home in the evening.
topic: Where my sister works and her day

questions.promptEnglish: Where does the older sister work?
questions.explanation: The speaker says "我姐姐在医院工作", so she works at a hospital.

questions.promptEnglish: What time does the older sister finish work?
questions.explanation: The speaker says she finishes work at "下午六点", which is six in the afternoon.
